title: 法吉伦特省大火   三人被拘捕 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 21:37 两名分别为19岁和21岁的男子，均为餐厅员工，于凌晨3点在阿卡雄（Arcachon）盆地以南的拉泰斯特德比克（La-Teste-de-Buch）被捕。波尔多检察官雷诺·戈德尔（Renaud Gaudeul）周六宣布，他们将于周三出庭受审，罪名是“向高速公路和体育中心方向燃放烟花”。 “故意纵火焚烧灌木丛” 同一天，另一名33岁的男子在午夜过后不久于波尔多郊区的洛尔蒙（Lormont）被捕，罪名是“故意纵火焚烧灌木丛”。雷诺·戈德尔表示，这名“职业是救护车司机”的男子“当时处于醉酒状态”，将于26日被带到检察官面前。 最后，一名26岁男子因在拉卡诺（Lacanau）吸烟被捕，前一天还在森林营地附近烧烤，他将于明年1月因危害他人生命罪受审。 周三，在波尔多附近的梅里尼亚克（Mérignac），两名专业消防员在一次灭火行动中殉职后，检察官宣布在禁止用火的三个省份，对森林用火行为，特别是乱扔烟头的行为，处以更严厉的处罚。检察官办公室表示，这种“仍然屡见不鲜”的行为，现在将面临一年监禁和1.5万欧元的罚款。

title: 突尼斯峭壁上的蓝白小镇被选入世遗 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 22:30 这座突尼斯文化遗产的瑰宝，以其蜿蜒的小巷、粉红色的三角梅和传统的镶钉木门而闻名，是游客的必游之地。然而，它原本就面临威胁，而今年冬季的异常降雨更是雪上加霜。 在韩国釜山举行的世界遗产委员会会议上，突尼斯国家遗产研究所（INP）在得知这一决定后欣喜地表示：“这是突尼斯文化遗产的历史性一天！” 突尼斯文化部对选入世遗，认为它认可了“西迪布萨伊德村作为文化、精神和艺术灵感之地的杰出普世价值，以及其独特的建筑风格”。这个村庄坐拥壮丽的地中海景色，于18世纪围绕着苏菲派圣人西迪·布·赛义德的陵墓和扎维亚（穆斯林宗教中心）发展起来。 村庄内有一座墓地，以及数座宫殿，例如宏伟的德·埃尔朗格男爵宫（现为国家音乐博物馆）和已故时装设计师阿泽丁·阿拉亚的别墅。 然而，村庄正面临着旅游业、土地压力和历史建筑损毁等日益严峻的挑战。文物保护人士经常呼吁进行修复工作。 今年冬天，近70年来前所未有的强降雨造成了破坏。山坡上的岩石崩落，泥浆涌入巷道，房屋受损，墙壁坍塌。

title: 博索纳罗长子正式参加下届总统大选 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 22:25 他平静地表示：“我可以更冷静、更爱笑、更平和、更温和，因我身体里流淌着博索纳罗的血！”他认为，如果左翼领袖卢拉赢得第四个非连续任期，巴西“可能会朝着独裁迈出重要一步”。阿根廷极右翼总统哈维尔·米莱作为特邀嘉宾出席了巴西主要保守党自由党（PL）在圣保罗举行的全国代表大会。大会吸引了上千人参加，正式启动了45岁的参议员博索纳罗的总统竞选活动。 这场竞选目前已由美国总统特朗普主导。特朗普是博索纳罗家族的盟友，他刚刚以涉嫌不公平贸易为由，对巴西加征了两轮惩罚性关税。作为拉丁美洲右翼势力崛起的重要人物，哈维尔·米莱曾在10月份发表激情澎湃的演讲，警告巴西存在“卢拉风险”，并强调巴西必须摆脱“对左翼的依附”。 一位名叫费尔南多·莫埃诺的50岁退休宪兵告诉法新社：“我们当然希望雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗当选，但就目前而言，弗拉维奥是最明智的选择”。莫埃诺也前来参加了此次活动。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在谈到他的父亲时泣不成声，他的父亲出现在一段由人工智能生成的视频中。自他开始服刑以来，法院已禁止他公开讲话，他目前正在家中接受27年的监禁。 弗拉维奥经常身穿巴西国家足球队的球衣，这件球衣已被博尔索纳罗的支持者们奉为象征。在帕卡恩布体育场旁的一个机库里，他的支持者们伴着鼓声和旗帜，反复高喊着“卢拉，小偷！”。 雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的长子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在竞选初期势头强劲，一度与对手不相上下，但近几周来，他的支持率有所下降。根据Datafolha研究所周五公布的民调显示，卢拉的支持率为48%，而博尔索纳罗的支持率为43%。 特朗普也让这位右翼候选人的处境更加复杂。卢拉将自己定位为巴西“主权”的捍卫者，指责弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗是“叛徒”，支持华盛顿对巴西发动的贸易战。 美国对巴西产品加征新关税之前，已于2025年对巴西产品加征了一项附加税，以报复老博索纳罗受审。这项最初的贸易制裁由弗拉维奥·博索纳罗的弟弟爱德华多·博索纳罗推动，在卢拉与美国方面短暂和解后，部分制裁被撤销。 最近，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗曾要求特朗普政府放弃加征新关税，以免卢拉从美国的压力中获取政治利益。但这一请求最终未能实现。

title: 美政坛黑马普拉特纳垮台  民主党换候选人 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 22:22 杰克逊先生曾是一名伐木工人，也是缅因州参议院前议长。在两周前普拉特纳退出竞选后，当地民主党分部匆忙召开了一次代表大会，杰克逊先生几乎全票当选。 普拉特纳在11月中期选举前夕曾是民主党的一大热门人物，但他在7月8日宣布退出参议员竞选，原因是他被指控强奸，但他否认了这些指控。这些指控终结了他本已丑闻缠身的政治生涯。 如果民主党希望重夺目前由共和党控制的参议院多数席位，缅因州的选举是11月民主党的关键选战之一。这个位于美国东北角的沿海乡村州自1992年以来一直主要投票支持民主党总统候选人。然而，现任参议员苏珊·柯林斯自1996年以来已四次以共和党人身份连任。 格雷厄姆·普拉特纳原定于几个月后与这位73岁的参议员对决，多项民调预测他将获胜，这得益于其以打击寡头政治和降低生活成本为核心的竞选纲领获得了相当多的民众支持。代表缅因州民主党进步派的特洛伊·杰克逊也传递着类似的信息，其核心是捍卫工人阶级免受经济和政治精英的侵害。 参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默（Chuck Schumer）和美国国会上院民主党竞选经理克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德（ Kirsten Gillibrand）参议员在一份声明中表示：“杰克逊是平价医疗保健和劳动人民的拥护者，他能够在缅因州动员民众的力量，并处于有利地位，能够击败比以往任何时候都更加脆弱的苏珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）”。

title: 古特雷斯首次访问叙利亚 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 22:33 古特雷斯先生在与叙利亚外长于大马士革举行的联合新闻发布会上表示：“国际社会必须帮助创造经济复苏所需的条件，协助恢复基本服务和基础设施，并扩大民生和就业机会。”此前，他将叙利亚局势描述为“关键时刻”。 据叙利亚国家通讯社SANA报道，联合国秘书长古特雷斯在访问大马士革老城后，于总统府会见了自2024年12月起担任叙利亚总统的艾哈迈德·沙拉（Ahmad al-Chareh）。 沙拉办公室发表声明称，此次会晤重点讨论了加强叙利亚与联合国在“人道主义和发展领域”的合作，以及“支持重建工作”。一位联合国官员告诉法新社，古特雷斯还参观了赛德纳亚（Saydnaya）监狱，该监狱是巴沙尔·阿萨德统治时期对反对派犯下暴行的象征。 他还在大马士革会见了部署在叙利亚戈兰高地缓冲区的联合国维和人员。戈兰高地部分地区于1981年被以色列单方面吞并。 巴沙尔·阿萨德政权倒台后，以色列向该地区派遣了军队。以色列军队还多次入侵叙利亚领土并进行轰炸，并声称有意在南部建立非军事区。 古特雷斯先生在新闻发布会上强调“充分尊重叙利亚主权的重要性”，并宣布戈兰高地附近的局势“令人无法接受”。他补充说：“我想提醒国际社会，戈兰高地是叙利亚领土。”在抵达大马士革机场迎接古特雷斯的叙利亚外长阿萨德·沙伊巴尼呼吁以色列“立即无条件撤出”其军队已推进的地区。自上台以来，艾哈迈德·沙拉已与其圣战主义背景决裂，并致力于吸引投资者进入叙利亚。叙利亚的基础设施在2011年至2024年的内战中遭受重创。 国际社会则呼吁他建立强大有效的机构，并建立包容多元的治理体系。 2025年3月，沙拉先生发表了《宪法宣言》，规定了为期五年的过渡期，期满后将举行选举。 与此同时，叙利亚议会已经成立，但其成员尚未选举产生，这引发了民间社会的批评。联合国秘书长发言人斯特凡·杜加里克重申了“所有叙利亚人需要更大的稳定、包容和繁荣”的必要性，并指出联合国将在“这一进程中”为叙利亚人民提供支持。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 中国国家足球队主教练邵佳一来访拜仁慕尼黑俱乐部 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 22:50 据拜仁慕尼黑足球俱乐部周五消息，中国国家足球队主教练邵佳一来访德甲冠军拜仁慕尼黑，与主教练文森特·孔帕尼、体育总监克里斯托夫·弗罗因德进行了交流，并接受拜仁慕尼黑市场与销售董事鲁文·卡斯珀赠送的球衣。这位46岁的前国脚曾于2002年至2011年征战德国足球甲级联赛，先后效力于科特布斯能源队、杜伊斯堡队和慕尼黑1860队。 鲁文·卡斯珀表示：“我们始终重视相互学习与经验交流，这样的访问能够让双方都受益。过去几年里，我们在邵佳一的祖国中国建立了多所足球学校，并自2014年以来通过位于上海的办公室，持续深入了解当地热爱足球的人们所关注的内容。拜仁慕尼黑在整个亚洲都享有良好的声誉，我们也非常高兴像邵佳一这样的国家队主教练能够关注我们俱乐部的工作方式。” 访问期间，邵佳一首先参观了拜仁青训学院（FC Bayern Campus）的健身中心、训练场、Skills.Lab 技术训练中心以及青训球场，并在参观过程中与新任比赛与教练发展主管贝恩哈德·泽恩布赫纳进行了简短交流。 随后，他前往位于塞贝纳大街的拜仁训练基地，现场观看了一线队训练。训练结束后，主教练文森特·孔帕尼专门抽出时间与他进行了深入交流，体育总监克里斯托夫·弗罗因德也参与了讨论。临别时，鲁文·卡斯珀赠送了一件拜仁球衣，作为此次访问的纪念。 邵佳一表示：“非常感谢拜仁慕尼黑向我敞开大门，让我有机会深入了解俱乐部的青训体系。这里完善而专业的培养体系，以及年轻球员如何一步步成长并达到职业足球水平，都给我留下了非常深刻的印象。” 自2023年以来，拜仁慕尼黑与中国一所中学合作，在上海附近的太仓设立了“拜仁慕尼黑太仓足球学校（FC Bayern Football School Taicang）”，开展青少年足球培养项目。 目前，学校每天都有一支男队和一支女队在拜仁教练团队的指导下进行训练。训练课程融入学校日常教学，让学生们全面学习拜仁青训学院的训练理念和培养方法。这种模式不仅保证了学生接受良好的学校教育，也使他们能够在高水平的足球环境中不断成长。作为“拜仁人才发展通道（FC Bayern Pathway）”的重要组成部分，太仓足球学校为中国有潜力的年轻球员提供了通往职业足球的发展路径。 2025年夏天，拜仁世界队（FC Bayern World Squad）还曾前往上海、杭州和太仓，开展训练营，并与当地俱乐部进行了多场友谊赛。

title: 失控野火肆虐法国西班牙 26万人被迫撤离 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 25/07/2026 - 23:19 法国和西班牙官员周六表示，失控野火肆虐两国境内，一共导致超过26万人被迫撤离。也包括法国葡萄酒产区波尔多在内地区面临大火威胁。 法新社报导，法国政府表示，西南部波尔多（Bordeaux）附近发生野火，已经撤离19万7000人。 法国内政部长努涅斯（Laurent Nunez）表示，庞大的空中巴士（Airbus）A400M军用运输机将加入即将展开的“漫长而且非常艰难”灭火行动，对抗肆虐西南部吉伦特省（Gironde）的野火。 法国内政部长指出，周六下午风向预期由西转东，可能会将火势推向波尔多，消防队和当局正在挖掘壕沟、施洒阻燃剂并且采取其他措施以阻隔火势。他表示，火场距离波尔多市约30公里。 当局下令火场和波尔多之间地区的居民撤离，包括该市西郊部分区域和其他城镇、村落。 法国总理勒克努（Sébastien Lecornu）形容这场野火规模空前，吉伦特省火势更是强劲到形成对外吹送的强风。 西班牙多处野火肆虐，尤其是首都所在的马德里自治区和邻近的阿维拉省（Ávila）最严重，目前火势仍处于失控状态，迄今已烧毁约3万5000公顷土地，紧急撤离人数高达8万8000人。 由于火情严峻，隶属国防部的军事应急部队（UME）已成立联合指挥部，由中央统一负责马德里和阿维拉两地的灭火工作，并已向10个自治区协调动用所有可用的资源，以扑灭马德里自治区历史上最严重的山林火灾。 由于马德里和阿维拉两地的火势已经融合成1条火线，凶猛火势正向马德里近郊的埃斯科里亚尔（El Escorial）地区蔓延，军事应急部队正在构筑防线以阻挡火舌。 埃斯科里亚尔山城以名列联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）世界文化遗产的“埃斯科里亚尔修道院”（Real Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial）闻名，具有高度文化与历史价值。 法国和西班牙政府都向欧盟请求援助，意大利和希腊的灭火飞机将陆续抵达西班牙。 据生态转型部的最新数据，今年西班牙已有超过13万公顷的土地被烧毁，与过去10年平均每年焚毁10万公顷山林的纪录相比，数字令人震惊。

title: 向核潜艇造船厂追加投入46亿澳元 澳防长：奥库斯协议正按部就班地推进 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 24/07/2026 - 15:38 负责建造澳大利亚依照澳英美三边安全伙伴关系（AUKUS），即奥库斯协议框架下核动力潜艇舰队的造船厂将获得46亿澳元（约合32亿美元）的资金支持。这笔追加投资将助力阿德莱德奥斯本造船厂新建潜艇建造设施的进一步开发。 相关公告于周五发布，发布时机正值澳大利亚执政党工党在阿德莱德召开第50届全国大会之际；此次大会似乎将避免就奥库斯协议引发公开辩论。 为筹备上述潜艇建造项目，数十亿澳元的州政府及联邦资金正投入多家造船厂；首艘奥库斯级攻击核潜艇（SSN-AUKUS）预计将于本世纪40年代初交付。据悉，此次追加的资金，是在今年早些时候宣布向澳大利亚海军基础设施公司（Australian Naval Infrastructure）旗下造船厂投入39亿澳元的基础上进行的。 根据奥库斯协议，除了将从美国引进的三艘弗吉尼亚级攻击核潜艇外，澳大利亚还将在奥斯本建造五艘核动力潜艇。 澳大利亚广播公司（ABC）报导指，澳大利亚亨特级护卫舰的建造工作已在进行之中，而这一新建的潜艇造船厂预计规模将达到现有设施的十倍。该开发项目包括建造一座长420米的制造车间，以及厂区内的舾装、总装和调试区域。 澳洲政府正着力强调建设期间将创造的就业机会：目前已有1100人在该项目现场工作，预计南澳还将新增数千个就业岗位。南澳州州长马里诺斯卡斯（Peter Malinauskas）表示，这是一项宏大的工程。他说：“在奥斯本投入数十亿澳元以建造全球最复杂的机器，其规模之大令人难以想象”。 澳大利亚副总理兼防长马尔斯（Richard Marles）表示，这笔资金是推动奥库斯协议核潜艇计划从构想走向现实的又一重要步骤。 马尔斯说：“这项投资是建立主权能力进程中的又一重要举措，而这种能力对于澳大利亚建造、操作、维护及保障未来的潜艇舰队至关重要”。 马尔斯强调，“目前在奥斯本开展的工作表明，奥库斯协议正按部就班地推进并已进入实施阶段，同时也为澳大利亚的产业界及广大从业人员创造了未来数十年的发展机遇”。 马尔斯周五在阿德莱德举行的工党全国大会上表示，奥库斯协议相关的开支问题将列入周末的议程；但他同时指出，在三年前的同一场大会上，经过一场“彻底的”辩论后，该计划获得了与会者的投票支持。 马尔斯指出：“从本届政府的角度来看，我们正在继续推进奥库斯协议的落实”。随着这项资金公告的发布，在奥库斯协议框架下投入奥斯本造船厂的澳洲纳税人资金总额已达85亿澳元。 然而，与奥库斯协议的其他项目相比，这笔资金仍显得相形见绌——例如去年宣布向西澳大利亚州亨德森造船厂投入的120亿澳元资金。 据了解，亨德森造船厂将负责维护澳大利亚计划从2030年代起投入使用的弗吉尼亚级核潜艇以及奥库斯级核潜艇。这项涉及数十亿澳元的新资金宣布之际，工党全国大会正在阿德莱德举行。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 中国证监会原副主席方星海官宣被查 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 24/07/2026 - 14:41 中央纪委国家监委网站周五发布消息指，中国证券监督管理委员会原党委委员、副主席方星海涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。 据人民财讯消息，今年6月24日，担任中国金融学会副会长的方星海曾出席夏季达沃斯论坛。方星海在2026夏季达沃斯论坛上表示，美国限制资本流入中国，反而在某种程度上刺激了中国的私募股权投资和风险投资。中国是一个高储蓄率国家，在这方面的潜力是非常巨大的。 公开资料显示，方星海，1964年5月出生，汉族，浙江乐清人，拥有清华大学经济管理学院学士学位、斯坦福大学经济系博士学位，2000年从银行进入证券业，出任银河证券管理委员会委员兼秘书长。在斯坦福大学攻读博士学位期间，方星海的导师据称是后来获得诺贝尔经济学奖的斯蒂格利茨。 方星海1998年8月起先后任中国建设银行集团协调委员会办公室主管、中国银河证券公司经营管理委员会秘书长。2001年7月起任上海证券交易所总经理助理、副总经理、党委委员。2005年12月任上海市金融服务办公室副主任（正局级），2007年10月任上海市金融工作党委副书记、市金融服务办公室主任。2013年9月任中央财经领导小组办公室经济一组巡视员，2014年6月任中央财经领导小组办公室经济四局局长。2015年10月任中国证券监督管理委员会副主席、党委委员。 2024年07月30日，证监会官网消息指，近日，国务院决定，任命李明为中国证券监督管理委员会副主席，免去方星海的中国证券监督管理委员会副主席职务。中央组织部通知，李明同志任中国证券监督管理委员会党委委员，免去方星海同志的中国证券监督管理委员会党委委员职务。

title: 反制欧盟涉俄制裁含陆港企业 中方将14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单 含莱茵金属 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 24/07/2026 - 14:10 中国商务部新闻发言人周五以答记者问方式表示，针对欧方周四正式发布第21轮对俄制裁措施，将14家中国内地和香港企业列单制裁，中方决定将拉法特集团等14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单，禁止出口经营者向上述实体出口两用物项，禁止境外组织和个人将原产于中华人民共和国的两用物项转移或提供给上述实体。公告自公布之日起正式实施。 欧盟周四通过了针对俄罗斯的第21轮制裁方案；中国商务部表示，有14家中国内地及香港企业被列入制裁名单。中国商务部在一份公告中指出，此番被中方禁止接收两用物项的欧盟实体包括德国汽车及军工制造商莱茵金属公司和波兰电子公司维戈尔光电（Vigo Photonics S.A.）等。 对此，欧盟委员会首席发言人皮尼奥（Paula Pinho）表示，欧盟正在分析中方新宣布的措施，并将与成员国及相关企业进行沟通。皮尼奥说：“我们将寻求与中国对应方进行澄清，以便更好地了解事态涉及的具体情况”。 两用物项是指既可用于民用又可用于军用的货物、软件或技术，其中包括制造无人机和芯片所必需的特定稀土元素。中方的出口管制清单主要针对美国和日本实体。今年4月，在欧盟将六家中国公司和一名自然人列入第20轮对俄制裁方案之际，中国商务部当月24日发布公告，公布将7家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单。 中国商务部新闻发言人当时指，“相关实体曾参与对台军售或与台勾连，相关措施仅针对两用物项，不影响中欧正常经贸往来，诚信守法的欧盟实体完全无需担心”。 周四，欧盟理事会通过声明表示，该机构当天通过了针对俄罗斯的第21轮限制性措施，以回应其对乌克兰发动的侵略战争。第21轮制裁方案包括严厉的经济制裁，针对那些对俄罗斯经济及其维持对乌侵略战争能力影响最大的行业；此外，还包括过去四年中规模最大的一批个人及实体列名行动，共涉及218个目标，其中包括48名个人和170个实体。 欧盟理事会指出，“为限制俄罗斯发动战争及实施打击——特别是利用远程无人机进行打击——的能力，今天的制裁方案新增了56个与俄罗斯军工复合体相关的个人及企业名单。其中包括37个与远程无人机直接相关的对象，旨在针对它们的生产及供应链实施制裁”。 欧盟理事会还提到，其“还将51个新实体列入受更严格出口限制——针对军民两用货物和技术——的名单，原因是这些实体支持俄罗斯针对乌克兰发动的侵略战争及其军事工业综合体。其中一些实体位于第三国（包括中国——含香港、印度、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、土耳其和阿联酋），协助俄罗斯规避出口限制，涉及微电子产品、计算机数控机床及半导体加工设备等”。 欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯（Kaja Kallas）表示，“每一轮制裁都在挤压俄罗斯的经济及其维持非法战争的能力。我们的第21轮制裁方案所列入的制裁对象数量创下了四年来的新高。此次制裁针对了一百多家银行和加密货币运营商、40多艘俄罗斯影子舰队的船只，以及俄罗斯和白俄罗斯境内的多家炼油厂。此外，制裁名单还涵盖了50多家军工实体，其中包括参与俄罗斯远程无人机生产的关键实体。只有在面临压力的情况下，俄罗斯才会愿意通过谈判结束其非法战争并停止杀害平民；而制裁正是施加这种压力的手段之一”。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 乌克兰无人机再袭俄罗斯电商巨头仓库，可能导致三人受伤 - RFI - 法国国际广播电台
description: 24/07/2026 - 13:51 俄罗斯最大电商平台Wildberries在圣彼得堡的几个仓库昨夜今晨遭到乌克兰无人机袭击。 临近圣彼得堡的列宁格勒州州长称，其中一座仓库遇袭后起火，并有三人受伤。俄罗斯指责乌克兰袭击民用设施。 Wildberries的中文名称是”野莓“，是俄罗斯最大的电子商务平台，被称作是俄罗斯亚马逊。这已经是短短几天之内，该电商平台的物流中心第三次遭遇乌克兰无人机袭击。 法新社24日发自圣彼得堡的报道引述该电商平台总裁发表的公报指出，集团在圣彼得堡以及在临近的列宁格勒州的一些物流中心遭遇袭击。公报显示，这些仓库部分区域和货物得以免于损坏，人员也得以撤离。 当日，列宁格勒州州长则表示，“野莓”一座仓库遭遇无人机袭击后起火，有三人受伤。据他所述，当夜有59架乌克兰无人机被击落。 法新社记者24日早晨在圣彼得堡看到城内升起滚滚浓烟。当地机场一度也因为无人机袭击而停飞数小时，导致数十个航班延误。 俄罗斯相关部门宣布，针对包括一个物流中心在内的民用设施遭遇袭击启动调查。乌克兰总统泽连斯基24日则祝贺乌军无人机命中目标，称这些仓库向俄罗斯军队提供物资。莫斯科对此矢口否认。 根据俄罗斯国防部发表的公报，昨夜今晨，俄罗斯防空部队在十几个地区以及被兼并的克罗米亚上空击落571架乌克兰无人机。 在此之前7月18日至19日夜间，乌克兰无人机就曾袭击”野莓“平台在莫斯科以及莫斯科东南480公里处的几个仓库，大火几乎摧毁了整个设施，并造成8名夜班员工丧生。两天后，该电商平台在俄罗斯南部两个地区的仓库又遭遇袭击。 乌克兰越来越频繁的对俄罗斯境内目标展开纵深打击。此前，目标集中在能源设施。这些袭击行动导致本是石油大国的俄罗斯出现燃油荒，90%的地区不得不限制燃油供给。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 安倍的“幽灵”：高市早苗捍卫“恩师”，推进民族主义议程
description: 赫海威2026年7月24日 Inside a hushed hall in Tokyo on a recent afternoon, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi of Japan stood before a giant portrait of her mentor, Shinzo Abe, the slain Japanese leader, and bowed. 近日的一个下午，在东京一座安静的大厅里，日本首相高市早苗站在她的恩师、遇刺身亡的日本领导人安倍晋三的巨幅画像前，鞠躬致敬。 It had been four years since Mr. Abe, a giant in Japanese politics and the country’s longest-serving prime minister, was shot and killed while giving a speech outside a train station. Ms. Takaichi, his protégé, had come to pay her respects — and to vow to carry on his vision. She told the crowd of right-wing politicians, activists, journalists and business leaders that she sometimes still imagined him sitting on the couch of the prime minister’s office. 安倍晋三是日本政坛巨头，也是该国在任时间最长的首相。他在车站外发表演讲时遇刺身亡，至今已过去四年。作为他的门生，高市早苗前来致哀，誓言继承他的遗志。她告诉在场的右翼政治人士、活动人士、记者和商界领袖，她有时仍会想象他坐在首相办公室的沙发上。 “I could never fill Prime Minister Abe’s shoes; my days are filled with nothing but criticism when compared to him,” she said. “Even so, I want to be a fighter politician like him. I tell myself that I must be.” “我永远无法取代安倍首相；与他相比，我的每一天都充斥着批评，”她说。“即便如此，我也想成为像他一样不停奋战的政治家。我告诉自己，我必须做到。” 2014年，高市早苗（中）与安倍晋三在东京合影。 Since winning election nine months ago, Ms. Takaichi, Japan’s first female prime minister, has frequently leveraged her ties to Mr. Abe to rally support for her nationalist agenda, often referring to him and his policies in major speeches. 自九个月前赢得选举以来，日本首位女首相高市早苗频繁利用她与安倍的关系来为她的民族主义议程争取支持，并经常在重要演讲中提及他以及他的政策。 She has hailed his vision of a more muscular Japan that is a driving force for strength and stability across Asia. She has invoked his legacy to call for greater military spending and the establishment of Japan’s first intelligence agency since World War II. She has dropped his name while wooing foreign leaders such as President Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India. 她赞扬安倍晋三关于建立一个更强大的日本并使之成为整个亚洲力量与稳定驱动力的愿景。她援引他的政治遗产，呼吁增加军事开支，并建立日本自二战以来的首个情报机构。在争取特朗普总统和印度总理莫迪等外国领导人的支持时，她也曾提及他的名字。 Yet Mr. Abe remains a divisive figure in Japan because of his break with decades of postwar pacifism; his support for changing how the country’s World War II-era history is taught in schools; and a rise in economic inequality during his tenure. His killing, by a 41-year-old man who was protesting the ruling Liberal Democratic Party’s ties to the Unification Church, a fringe religious group, prompted a range of reactions. While many people were outraged, some sympathized with the assassin, noting his difficult childhood. Others said that a state funeral for Mr. Abe was a waste of money. (His assassin, Tetsuya Yamagami, was sentenced to life in prison earlier this year.) 然而，安倍晋三在日本仍是一个引发分歧的人物，因为他打破了数十年的战后和平主义；支持改变学校对二战时期历史的教学方式；在他的任期内，经济不平等现象出现加剧。他被一名41岁男子刺杀，该男子以此抗议执政的自民党与边缘宗教团体“统一教会”的关系。这一事件引发了一系列反应。虽然许多人感到愤怒，但也有人理解凶手，同情他艰难的童年。还有人说为安倍晋三举行国葬是浪费金钱。（今年早些时候，刺杀他的凶手山上彻也被判处终身监禁。） Despite Mr. Abe’s complicated legacy, Ms. Takaichi has emerged as one of his chief defenders, hailing him as a transformative leader who elevated Japan’s stature on the global stage. 尽管安倍晋三留下的政治遗产错综复杂，但高市早苗已成为他的主要捍卫者之一，她称赞安倍晋三是一位具有变革精神的领导人，提升了日本在全球舞台上的地位。 This triumphant account of Mr. Abe’s tenure has been on display recently across Japan, including at a sold-out exhibition by the Shinzo Abe Digital Museum, an organization founded by Mr. Abe’s allies in business and government. The exhibition featured more than 100 objects from his life, including the microphone he was holding when he was shot on July 8, 2022, in the ancient city of Nara, Ms. Takaichi’s hometown. 最近，对安倍任期的这种颂扬式叙述在日本各地展示，其中包括“安倍晋三数字博物馆“举办的一场门票售罄的展览，“安倍晋三数字博物馆“由安倍在商政两界的盟友创办。该展览的展品包括他生前的100多件物品，包括2022年7月8日他在古城奈良遇刺时手里拿着的麦克风，那里也是高市早苗的故乡。 安倍晋三的遗孀安倍昭惠（左）出席了一场展出安倍生前物品的展览。 Kentaro Takahashi for The New York Times2022年7月安倍晋三遭枪击时手中握着的麦克风。 Mr. Abe’s widow, Akie Abe, said during a visit to the exhibition in Nara on Sunday that her husband’s message “has been entrusted to” Ms. Takaichi. 安倍的遗孀安倍昭惠周日参观在奈良举行的展览时表示，她丈夫的使命“已托付给”高市早苗。 Same Playbook, New Challenges 相同的策略，全新的挑战 Ms. Takaichi, who met Mr. Abe in the 1990s when they were both rising politicians and later served in his cabinet, has sought to portray herself as the inheritor of his legacy, at a time when Japan is facing rising tensions with China, Russia and North Korea. 高市早苗在20世纪90年代结识安倍晋三，当时两人都是冉冉升起的政治新星，她后来还在安倍内阁中任职。在日本与中、俄、朝三国紧张局势不断升级之际，她一直试图将自己塑造成安倍晋三政治遗产的继承人。 “She’s embracing what Abe did and running with it,” said Sheila A. Smith, a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations. “她正在全盘接受安倍晋三的一切，并以此为基础继续前进，”美国外交关系委员会高级研究员希拉·史密斯说。 The question now, analysts say, is whether Ms. Takaichi can adapt Mr. Abe’s vision to new challenges. Among them: 分析人士表示，现在的问题是，高市早苗能否将安倍晋三的愿景进行调整，以适应新的挑战。其中包括： • Beijing is rapidly expanding its military and economic influence in Asia, and has led a monthslong campaign against Ms. Takaichi to punish her for a comment she made in support of Taiwan, which China claims as its territory. • 北京正迅速扩大其在亚洲的军事和经济影响力，并针对高市早苗发起了一场持续数月的攻势，以惩罚她发表的支持台湾的言论。中国声称台湾是其领土。 • Japan’s economic outlook has grown more complicated as the country grapples with inflation for the first time in decades and a stubbornly weak yen. • 随着日本几十年来首次面临通货膨胀，加上日元持续疲软，该国的经济前景变得更加复杂。 • The country’s demographic decline is also accelerating, hurting the economy, causing labor shortages and undermining defense priorities like military recruitment. • 日本的人口衰退也在加速，这拖累了经济，导致了劳动力短缺，并削弱了征兵等国防优先事项。 Mieko Nakabayashi, a political science professor at Waseda University in Tokyo, said Ms. Takaichi was clinging to Mr. Abe’s playbook while ignoring new realities. She pointed to Ms. Takaichi’s support for expansionary fiscal policies, which some analysts say could exacerbate inflation. 东京早稻田大学政治学教授中林美惠子表示，高市早苗一味沿袭安倍晋三的策略，却忽视了新的现实。她指出，高市早苗支持扩张性财政政策，一些分析人士称这可能会加剧通货膨胀。 “Her popularity depends on Mr. Abe’s legacy,” Ms. Nakabayashi said. “Her biggest selling point is that she is trying to realize everything that Mr. Abe wanted to do, at whatever cost.” “她的支持率依赖于安倍的政治遗产，”中林美惠子说。“她最大的卖点在于，无论付出什么代价，她都致力于实现安倍想要做的一切。” 在日本与中俄朝紧张局势不断升级之际，高市早苗一直试图将自己塑造成安倍晋三政治遗产的继承人。 Ms. Takaichi worked for Mr. Abe during his first stint as prime minister in 2006, and during his second term, which began in 2012. She rose to the powerful position of minister for internal affairs and communications. 高市早苗曾在2006年安倍晋三首次担任首相期间以及始于2012年的第二个任期内为他工作。她一路晋升，升任总务大臣这一要职。 During that time she became a fierce defender of his policies, including efforts to revise Japan’s Constitution to unfetter its military, and his economic program, which emphasized cheap cash and government stimulus efforts. 在那期间，她成为安倍晋三政策的坚定捍卫者，包括旨在修改日本宪法以解除军队束缚的努力，以及强调低成本资金和政府刺激措施的经济计划。 “I was deeply drawn not only to his qualities as a politician but also to his character as a human being,” Ms. Takaichi said of her work with Mr. Abe, in a letter on display at the new exhibition. 在此次新展览中展出的一封信中，高市早苗如此描述她与安倍晋三共事的经历：“我不仅深深地被他作为政治人士的品质所吸引，也被他作为一个人的人格魅力所吸引。” Tobias Harris, the founder of the advisory firm Japan Foresight and the author of a book on Mr. Abe, said that it remained to be seen whether Ms. Takaichi had fully grasped the lessons of his tenure. He said it was notable that she identified with Mr. Abe’s fighting spirit, given that Mr. Abe’s success in his second term came in part from tempering those impulses. 咨询公司“日本远见”的创始人、一部有关安倍晋三书籍的作者托比亚斯·哈里斯表示，高市早苗是否充分吸取了安倍晋三任期内的教训目前还有待观察。他说，值得注意的是，她认同安倍晋三的战斗精神，而事实上，安倍晋三在第二任期的成功部分源于他克制了那些冲动。 “We have seen her willingness to bulldoze her opponents over and over again,” Mr. Harris said. “But as Abe learned, there is a cost to pay for that.” “我们一次又一次地看到她不惜碾压对手的意愿，”哈里斯说。“但正如安倍所意识到的那样，这种做法是要付出代价的。” 安倍晋三回顾展入口处的参观者。 The Shinzo Abe Digital Museum raised more than $338,000 from individual donors for the exhibition. On a recent day, visitors left notes on a wall with messages such as “You were our hope!” and “We will carry forward your mission.” A shop sold Abe-themed calendars and playing cards that included scenes of him golfing with President Trump. “安倍晋三数字博物馆”从个人捐助者那里筹集了超过33.8万美元用于此次展览。前不久的一天，参观者在墙上留下了诸如“您曾是我们的希望！”和“我们将继承您的使命”之类的留言。一家商店出售以安倍晋三为主题的日历和扑克牌，其中包括他与特朗普总统打高尔夫球的场景。 The exhibition became a gathering spot for his supporters, drawing nearly 7,000 visitors in Tokyo and Nara, including more than a half dozen of Ms. Takaichi’s cabinet officials. 展览成为安倍晋三支持者的聚集地，在东京和奈良吸引了近7000名参观者，包括超过六名高市内阁官员。 Mr. Abe’s supporters are hopeful about Ms. Takaichi, though they said she would face different challenges than Mr. Abe, including disruptions to the energy supply, foreign wars and political volatility in the United States. 安倍晋三的支持者对高市早苗抱有希望，尽管他们表示，她将面临与安倍晋三不同的挑战，包括能源供应中断、外国战争以及美国的政治动荡。 Fumiyo Kato, 48, who runs a weather data company in Tokyo, cried during a recent visit to the exhibition as she viewed Mr. Abe’s personal artifacts: a childhood notebook, a portrait of his father, a wedding photo. She said that Ms. Takaichi appeared to be carrying on his legacy, but it was too early to say whether she would succeed. 48岁的加藤文代（音）在东京经营一家气象数据公司。最近参观展览时，她看到安倍的个人物品——一本童年笔记本、一张他父亲的肖像、一张结婚照——不禁流下了眼泪。她说高市早苗似乎继承了他的遗志，但现在断言她是否会成功还为时过早。 “Abe was a great man,” she said. “He can’t be easily replaced.” “安倍是一位伟人，”她说。“他不能被轻易取代。” Hisako Ueno对本文有报道贡献。 赫海威(Javier C. Hernández)是《纽约时报》东京分社社长，领导时报对日本及周边地区的报道。在过去十年的大部分时间里，他一直在亚洲进行报道，此前曾任驻华记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

On a recent day, visitors left notes on a wall with messages such as “You were our hope!” and “We will carry forward your mission.” A shop sold Abe-themed calendars and playing cards that included scenes of him golfing with President Trump. “安倍晋三数字博物馆”从个人捐助者那里筹集了超过33.8万美元用于此次展览。前不久的一天，参观者在墙上留下了诸如“您曾是我们的希望！”和“我们将继承您的使命”之类的留言。一家商店出售以安倍晋三为主题的日历和扑克牌，其中包括他与特朗普总统打高尔夫球的场景。 The exhibition became a gathering spot for his supporters, drawing nearly 7,000 visitors in Tokyo and Nara, including more than a half dozen of Ms. Takaichi’s cabinet officials. 展览成为安倍晋三支持者的聚集地，在东京和奈良吸引了近7000名参观者，包括超过六名高市内阁官员。 Mr. Abe’s supporters are hopeful about Ms. Takaichi, though they said she would face different challenges than Mr. Abe, including disruptions to the energy supply, foreign wars and political volatility in the United States. 安倍晋三的支持者对高市早苗抱有希望，尽管他们表示，她将面临与安倍晋三不同的挑战，包括能源供应中断、外国战争以及美国的政治动荡。 Fumiyo Kato, 48, who runs a weather data company in Tokyo, cried during a recent visit to the exhibition as she viewed Mr. Abe’s personal artifacts: a childhood notebook, a portrait of his father, a wedding photo. She said that Ms. Takaichi appeared to be carrying on his legacy, but it was too early to say whether she would succeed. 48岁的加藤文代（音）在东京经营一家气象数据公司。最近参观展览时，她看到安倍的个人物品——一本童年笔记本、一张他父亲的肖像、一张结婚照——不禁流下了眼泪。她说高市早苗似乎继承了他的遗志，但现在断言她是否会成功还为时过早。 “Abe was a great man,” she said. “He can’t be easily replaced.” “安倍是一位伟人，”她说。“他不能被轻易取代。” Hisako Ueno对本文有报道贡献。 赫海威( Javier C. Hernández )是《纽约时报》东京分社社长，领导时报对日本及周边地区的报道。在过去十年的大部分时间里，他一直在亚洲进行报道，此前曾任驻华记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 对韩国而言，美沙核协议暴露美国双重标准
description: CHOE SANG-HUN2026年7月24日韩国庆州月城核电站附近的一处海滩，摄于2022年。韩国核电产业规模位居世界前列。 Kim Hong-Ji/Reuters For decades, South Korea was an example of the United States’ unyielding stance on nuclear nonproliferation. 几十年来，韩国一直是美国在核不扩散问题上保持坚定立场的一个典型例子。 In the 1970s, the United States pressured South Korea, a steadfast ally with whom it shared nuclear technology, to give up a clandestine nuclear weapons program. Then, it barred the country from enriching its own reactor fuel. The restriction held firm even after Seoul joined a nonproliferation treaty, accepted rigorous safeguards, and built one of the world’s largest nuclear power industries. Nor did the policy waver as North Korea built a nuclear arsenal on the South’s doorstep. 上世纪70年代，美国曾向韩国施压，要求其放弃秘密核武器计划——尽管韩国是与其共享核技术的坚定盟友。此后，美国又禁止韩国自行浓缩反应堆燃料。即便韩国加入了不扩散核武器条约、接受了严格的保障监督，并建成了规模居世界前列的核电产业，这一限制也未曾松动。即便朝鲜在韩国门口建成了核武库，美国的这一政策也未动摇。 Now, the Trump administration has apparently shattered that standard. By striking a deal that could lead to Saudi Arabia enriching uranium on its own soil, Washington has prompted an inevitable question in Seoul: Why Saudi Arabia, and not us? 如今，特朗普政府似乎打破了这一标准。华盛顿与沙特达成一项可能导致其在境内进行铀浓缩的协议，这在首尔引发了一个不可避免的问题：为什么是沙特，而不是我们？ South Korea has long negotiated with the United States for enrichment rights. While its Foreign Ministry declined to comment directly on the U.S.–Saudi accord, it said on Thursday that it was closely monitoring “trends in U.S. foreign policy on the nuclear energy sector” for potential impacts on its own talks. While the deal raises expectations for progress in South Korea’s negotiations with Washington, it could also seed deep friction in the seven-decade-old alliance if Washington continues to ignore Seoul’s demands. 长期以来，韩国一直与美国就铀浓缩权进行谈判。虽然韩国外交部拒绝就美沙协议直接置评，但周四表示正在密切关注“美国核能领域外交政策趋势”对韩美谈判可能产生的影响。虽然该协议提升了人们对韩美谈判取得进展的预期，但如果华盛顿继续无视首尔的要求，也可能在两国长达70年的同盟关系中埋下深刻分歧的种子。 “It is clear that the Trump administration is willing to make major geopolitical bargains with less emphasis on international norms and institutions,” said Leif-Eric Easley, an international studies professor at Ewha Womans University in Seoul. 首尔梨花女子大学国际研究教授莱夫·埃里克·伊斯利表示：“很明显，特朗普政府愿意进行重大的地缘政治交易，而不太重视国际规范和制度。” On Thursday, President Trump said the agreement is contingent on Saudi Arabia normalizing relations with Israel, putting its immediate future in doubt. 周四，特朗普总统表示，这项协议的前提条件是沙特阿拉伯与以色列实现关系正常化，这使协议的近期前景充满不确定性。 Still, the contrast between Washington’s dealings with Saudi Arabia and South Korea exposes a stark double standard in American nuclear policy. Washington appears to have paved the way for enrichment rights for Saudi Arabia for power plants it has yet to build, while denying them to South Korea, which already operates 26 reactors and plans to build more to meet surging energy demands for the A.I. revolution. It has exempted Saudi Arabia from intrusive inspections by the International Atomic Energy Agency, which South Korea has long submitted to to assure the international community that no technology is diverted to weapons projects. 然而，华盛顿对待沙特和韩国的不同方式暴露出美国核政策中明显的双重标准。华盛顿似乎为沙特尚未建成的核电站铺平了铀浓缩的道路；与此同时，它却拒绝给予韩国同样的权利，后者已在运行26座核反应堆，并计划建设更多核电设施，以满足人工智能革命带来的不断增长的能源需求。美国还豁免沙特接受国际原子能机构的侵入性检查，而韩国长期以来一直接受这类检查，向国际社会证明其核技术不会被转用于核武项目。 去年，沙特阿拉伯王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼与特朗普总统在白宫举行会晤。 Many in South Korea find this American concession especially jarring given the geopolitical risks. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia has openly warned that his kingdom would build a bomb if Iran did. By contrast, South Korea’s president, Lee Jae Myung, has repeatedly promised that Seoul will not pursue nuclear weapons, choosing instead to rely on the U.S. security guarantees for deterrence as North Korea expands its nuclear arsenal. 许多韩国人认为，考虑到地缘政治风险，美国的这一让步尤其令人难以接受。沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼曾公开警告，如果伊朗造出核弹，沙特也会跟进。相比之下，韩国总统李在明已多次承诺首尔不会追求核武器，而是在朝鲜不断扩大核武库的情况下，继续依靠美国提供的安全保障来实现威慑。 “The danger of a breakout by Seoul is likely lower because of its continuous close coordination with Washington on extended deterrence,” Professor Easley said, adding that unlike in the Middle East, “major war on the Korean Peninsula has been deterred for decades.” “首尔核突破的风险可能更低，因为它与华盛顿在延伸威慑方面持续密切协调，”伊斯利教授表示。他还指出，与中东不同，“朝鲜半岛几十年来一直没有发生大规模战争。” As South Korea was pressured to abandon its weapons program, it signed a treaty with the United States in 1972 that barred enrichment without American consent. Even during a 2015 revision of the agreement, Washington mandated that any enrichment require written bilateral agreement. 在韩国被迫放弃核武器计划的时候，它在1972年与美国签署了一项条约，未经美国同意不得进行铀浓缩。即使在2015年修订该协议时，华盛顿仍规定任何浓缩活动都需经双边书面同意。 Consequently, South Korea imports all of its uranium fuel. Seoul now wants independent enrichment capabilities to secure its fuel supply chain. It also wants to recycle spent fuel to reduce waste storage volume — a massive political headache in a densely populated country with a vocal environmental movement. 因此，韩国目前所有铀燃料都依赖进口。如今，首尔希望获得独立的铀浓缩能力，以保障燃料供应链安全。同时，它也希望能够对乏燃料进行再处理，以减少核废料储存量——这对于一个人口密集、环保运动活跃的国家而言是一个巨大的政治难题。 The U.S.-Saudi deal will likely take center stage when South Korea and the United States resume talks to implement the comprehensive investment and security agreement struck by Mr. Trump and Mr. Lee in November. 当韩国和美国重启谈判，以落实特朗普和李在明去年11月达成的全面投资和安全协议时，美沙协议很可能成为焦点。 Back then, Washington appeared to address Seoul’s grievances by promising to support a “process that will lead to” civil enrichment of uranium and reprocessing of spent fuel by South Korea. He also approved South Korea’s plan to build nuclear-powered attack submarines, pledging American help to secure uranium fuel for the vessels. 当时，华盛顿回应了韩国的不满，承诺支持一个“将促成”韩国进行民用铀浓缩和乏燃料再处理的进程。特朗普还批准了韩国建造核动力攻击潜艇的计划，并承诺美国将帮助韩国确保这些潜艇所需的铀燃料供应。 However, the broad wording left critical details unresolved, including whether South Korea could operate enrichment or reprocessing facilities on its own soil and whether those facilities would also supply fuel for nuclear submarines. 然而，协议中的宽泛措辞留下了关键问题尚未解决，包括韩国是否可以在本国领土上自行运营铀浓缩或乏燃料再处理设施，以及这些设施是否也能为核潜艇提供燃料。 Talks aimed at resolving such questions were sidetracked by a separate trade dispute, and working-level negotiations only resumed last month. 旨在解决这些问题的谈判因贸易争端而中断，工作层面的谈判上月才重新恢复。 South Korea aims to launch its first domestic nuclear submarine within a decade, using low-enriched fuel to ease proliferation fears. But the pathway remains unclear. 韩国计划在十年内让第一艘国产核动力潜艇下水，并使用低浓缩铀燃料，以降低核扩散方面的担忧。但目前实现这一目标的路径仍不明确。 In 2004, the I.A.E.A. investigated South Korean scientists for unauthorized enrichment experiments. Today, many in South Korea openly view uranium enrichment as a vital path to “nuclear latency” — the ability to rapidly develop weapons if Mr. Trump’s transactional diplomacy renders the U.S. security guarantee, known as the nuclear umbrella, unreliable. 2004年，国际原子能机构曾调查韩国科学家进行未经授权的铀浓缩实验一事。如今，韩国国内许多人公开将铀浓缩视为成为“核门槛”国家的重要途径。“核门槛国家”意味着，如果特朗普式的交易型外交导致美国的安全承诺（即核保护伞）变得不再可靠，韩国能够迅速发展核武器。 Despite the South Korean government’s repeated denials of any intent to build atomic weapons, public and political backing for a sovereign nuclear deterrent has increased in recent years, while North Korea’s nuclear threats have escalated. In December, Pyongyang unveiled the hull of what it described as its first nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine. 尽管韩国政府多次否认有意发展核武器，但近年来，随着朝鲜核威胁不断升级，韩国公众和政界对建立自主核威慑力量的支持正在增加。去年12月，平壤曝光了一艘它称之为首艘核动力战略制导导弹潜艇的艇体。 Choe Sang-Hun是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

He also approved South Korea’s plan to build nuclear-powered attack submarines, pledging American help to secure uranium fuel for the vessels. 当时 ，华盛顿回应了韩国的不满，承诺支持一个“将促成”韩国进行民用铀浓缩和乏燃料再处理的进程。特朗普还 批准 了韩国建造核动力攻击潜艇的计划，并承诺美国将帮助韩国确保这些潜艇所需的铀燃料供应。 However, the broad wording left critical details unresolved, including whether South Korea could operate enrichment or reprocessing facilities on its own soil and whether those facilities would also supply fuel for nuclear submarines. 然而，协议中的宽泛措辞留下了关键问题尚未解决，包括韩国是否可以在本国领土上自行运营铀浓缩或乏燃料再处理设施，以及这些设施是否也能为核潜艇提供燃料。 Talks aimed at resolving such questions were sidetracked by a separate trade dispute , and working-level negotiations only resumed last month. 旨在解决这些问题的谈判因 贸易争端 而中断，工作层面的谈判上月才重新恢复。 South Korea aims to launch its first domestic nuclear submarine within a decade, using low-enriched fuel to ease proliferation fears. But the pathway remains unclear. 韩国计划在十年内让第一艘国产核动力潜艇下水，并使用低浓缩铀燃料，以降低核扩散方面的担忧。但目前实现这一目标的路径仍不明确。 In 2004, the I.A.E.A. investigated South Korean scientists for unauthorized enrichment experiments. Today, many in South Korea openly view uranium enrichment as a vital path to “nuclear latency” — the ability to rapidly develop weapons if Mr. Trump’s transactional diplomacy renders the U.S. security guarantee, known as the nuclear umbrella , unreliable. 2004年，国际原子能机构曾调查韩国科学家进行未经授权的铀浓缩实验一事。如今，韩国国内许多人公开将铀浓缩视为成为“核门槛”国家的重要途径。“核门槛国家”意味着，如果特朗普式的交易型外交导致美国的安全承诺（即 核保护伞 ）变得不再可靠，韩国能够迅速发展核武器。 Despite the South Korean government’s repeated denials of any intent to build atomic weapons, public and political backing for a sovereign nuclear deterrent has increased in recent years, while North Korea’s nuclear threats have escalated. In December, Pyongyang unveiled the hull of what it described as its first nuclear-powered strategic guided missile submarine. 尽管韩国政府多次否认有意发展核武器，但近年来，随着朝鲜核威胁不断升级，韩国 公众和政界 对建立自主 核威慑力量的支持正在增加 。去年12月，平壤曝光了一艘它称之为首艘核动力战略制导导弹潜艇的艇体。 Choe Sang-Hun 是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 印度青年抗议：一场莫迪始料未及的政治危机
description: ALEX TRAVELLI2026年7月24日周四，新德里街头，人们从抗议标语前走过。 Saumya Khandelwal for The New York Times Narendra Modi, the powerful and acutely image-conscious prime minister of India, is suddenly facing a political problem he had not anticipated on entering his 13th year in office. 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪一向强势且极其在意形象。在执掌权力进入第13个年头之际，他突然面临一个始料未及的政治难题。 Mr. Modi has had his eye trained on economic anxieties for much of the year, which were sharpened by the external effects of the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran. His government had to manage shortages of imported oil and gas, distributing the costs among businesses and ordinary citizens. 今年以来，莫迪大部分时间都在关注经济层面的焦虑情绪，而美国和以色列对伊朗发动的战争所带来的外部影响又进一步加剧了这种焦虑。他的政府不得不应对进口石油和天然气短缺的问题，需要在企业和普通民众之间分摊由此产生的成本。 But it was another sort of economic pressure that has now caught up with him and helped drive thousands of students to protest in the capital: The crumbling and sometimes crooked machinery of India’s underfunded education system, along with a painful lack of jobs for the millions of graduates it produces. 但真正让他陷入困境的是另一种经济压力——也正是这种压力驱使数千名学生走上首都街头抗议：印度资金不足的教育体系本身已经摇摇欲坠、腐败丛生，而这一体系每年培养出的数百万毕业生又面临严峻的就业难问题。 After 25 days of protest, and nearly three days since police used batons and tear gas to disperse protesters, Mr. Modi was still struggling for a meaningful response. On Thursday, he posted on social media that “Nothing is more important than the welfare and future of our youth!” He has promised fast-track tribunals to punish the individuals who spoiled the exam but nothing else. 抗议已持续25天，警察动用警棍和催泪弹驱散示威者也已过去将近三天，莫迪仍在苦苦寻找一个有分量的回应。周四，他在社交媒体上发帖称，“没有什么比我们年轻人的福祉和未来更重要！”他承诺将设立快速审理法庭，惩处泄题丑闻的相关人员，但除此之外没有提出其他措施。 This sounded both late and lame to the protesters who were on the street, infuriating many of them further. The movement’s demands are widening rapidly from their initial complaints focused on over accountability for the scrapping of a college-entrance exam to, among other things, compensation for the protesters injured in clashes on Monday. 这番表态在街头抗议者听来既嫌太迟，又显苍白无力，反而让许多人更加愤慨。这场运动的诉求正在迅速扩大：从最初要求对大学入学考试取消一事追究责任，延伸至为周一冲突中受伤的抗议者提供赔偿等多项诉求。 本周，印度总理莫迪在新德里。他于周四首次就抗议者的诉求公开发表评论。 Sajjad Hussain/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Many of the protesters are students, and many others have jobs, but they share a sense of desperation and rage about education and employment prospects. Smaller protests have emerged in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad and other cities, raising demands that Mr. Modi will find difficult if not impossible to answer in the short term. 许多抗议者是学生，也有不少是上班族，但他们对教育和就业前景都抱有共同的绝望和愤怒。孟买、班加罗尔、艾哈迈达巴德等城市也出现了规模较小的抗议活动，这些诉求将让莫迪在短期内很难、甚至无法作出回应。 Arsh Gupta, a 20-year-old college student, said “there are a lot of feelings” that brought him to the central protest site on Thursday. The original testing failure “is not a small thing at all,” he said, but he was driven more by other issues, most of all “the feeling that we’re living under a dictatorship.” 20岁的大学生阿尔什·古普塔说，促使他周四来到中央抗议现场的原因是“许许多多的情绪”。最初的考试事故“绝非小事”，他说，但驱使他前来的更多是其他问题，尤其是“我们感觉自己生活在一个独裁政权之下”。 At the forefront of the protests is the Cockroach Janta Party, not an actual political party but a movement that takes its name from an insult made by the chief justice of India’s Supreme Court. It is taking aim at these much longer-term crises. The education system is in disarray, the C.J.P.’s spokesmen said, demanding that corrupt and bungling officials must face accountability. 站在抗议最前沿的是“蟑螂人民党”。这并不是一个真正的政党，而是一场以印度最高法院首席大法官曾使用的一句侮辱性言论命名的社会运动。该运动正在将矛头指向印度长期存在的危机。蟑螂人民党的发言人表示，印度教育体系已陷入混乱，要求腐败无能的官员必须被追责。 India’s economy may be growing at a healthy rate, but it offers the protesters little hope. While the gross rate of unemployment looks low, recorded as between 4 and 7 percent, most workers fall outside the formal sector and never get counted. Young adults, especially those who have earned degrees and want to put them to use, are the most frustrated. Nearly 40 percent are unemployed, according to the State of Working India 2026 report published by Azim Premji University. 印度经济或许仍保持着健康增长速度，但这并没有给这些抗议者带来多少希望。虽然官方统计的失业率看起来并不高，大约在4%到7%之间，但大多数劳动者都处于非正规就业部门，从未被纳入统计。年轻人——尤其是拿到学位、渴望一展所长的大学毕业生——是最沮丧的群体。阿齐姆·普雷姆吉大学发布的《2026年印度就业状况报告》显示，印度年轻人的失业率接近40%。 The protesters’ anger intensified after Monday’s show of force by the police, and appears to have turned against the whole of India’s government. 警方周一采取强硬行动后，抗议者的愤怒进一步升级，矛头似乎已转向整个印度政府。 None of this was on Mr. Modi’s menu for 2026. 这一切都不在莫迪的2026年议程中。 本周早些时候，新德里，安保人员发射催泪瓦斯驱散抗议者。 The Iran war presented a tough series of challenges but also an opportunity to make a fresh break. Economic difficulties had been piling up for months while Mr. Modi’s party was also fighting to win power in a series of state elections. 伊朗战争带来了一系列严峻考验，但同时也提供了一个重新出发的机会。在莫迪的执政党忙于角逐一系列邦级选举之际，经济困难已持续数月。 After winning control of state governments culminating with West Bengal in May, Mr. Modi turned to keeping down inflation and reining in the public’s expectations. 在赢得多个邦的控制权，并于5月最终拿下西孟加拉邦后，莫迪开始致力于控制通胀，并降低公众对政府的期待。 Mr. Modi started warning Indians that painful times were coming. Food prices were rising, and the rupee was nose-diving. 莫迪开始警告印度民众，困难时期即将到来。食品价格在上涨，卢比在大幅贬值。 Around the same time, it emerged that the questions to a national medical college entrance exam had been leaked, so the results for millions of students were canceled. The C.J.P. took up the test-takers’ cause almost instantly. 大约在同一时期，一场全国医学院入学考试的试题泄露事件曝光，导致数百万学生的考试成绩被取消。蟑螂人民党几乎在第一时间站出来支持这些考生。 The protest’s leadership is, however, dispersed and nonprofessional. That makes it unlike the farmers who staged a siege-like protest around Delhi for more than a year from 2020 to 2021, or even a current protest on behalf of Jammu and Kashmir, whose elected leader is trying to restore its statehood. 不过，这场抗议的领导结构较为分散，也缺乏专业性。这使它不同于2020年至2021年农民在德里周边发动的、持续一年多的围困式抗议，也不同于目前围绕查谟和克什米尔问题展开的抗议——后者有一位民选领导人试图恢复该地区的邦地位。 These mostly middle-class protesters cannot easily be made to look marginal. 这些大多来自中产阶级的抗议者很难被简单描绘成边缘群体。 Nor can the issues they raise be answered overnight. The causes of India’s jobs crisis have been brewing for a long time. A great deal of students’ time and their families’ money has been invested in courses that routinely fail to equip them for the workplace. 他们所提出的问题同样无法一夜之间给出答案。印度就业危机的根源已经酝酿积累了很长时间。学生们投入了大量时间，家庭耗费了高昂资金投入，但这些课程往往无法真正帮助他们获得进入职场所需的技能。 Amit Basole, an economist and lead author of the State of Working India report, noted that young graduates in India have always been disproportionately unemployed. But their number has grown terrifically in recent years, along with the debt their families owe for their educations. 《印度就业状况报告》的主要作者、经济学家阿米特·巴索莱指出，印度年轻大学毕业生一直以来的失业比例就明显偏高。但近年来，他们的数量急剧增长，与此同时，他们的家庭为了支付教育费用而背负的债务也不断增长。 “It’s a systematic failure. If the government’s not responsible, then who is?” asked Pranavi Tripathi, a 22-year-old business graduate protesting in Delhi on Thursday. “这是系统性的失败。如果政府不负责，那谁负责？”22岁的商科毕业生普拉纳维·特里帕蒂周四在德里参加抗议时说道。 Alex Travelli是时报驻新德里记者，报道印度和南亚其他地区的商业和经济新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

A great deal of students’ time and their families’ money has been invested in courses that routinely fail to equip them for the workplace. 他们所提出的问题同样无法一夜之间给出答案。印度就业危机的根源已经酝酿积累了很长时间。学生们投入了大量时间，家庭耗费了高昂资金投入，但这些课程往往无法真正帮助他们获得进入职场所需的技能。 Amit Basole, an economist and lead author of the State of Working India report, noted that young graduates in India have always been disproportionately unemployed. But their number has grown terrifically in recent years, along with the debt their families owe for their educations. 《印度就业状况报告》的主要作者、经济学家阿米特·巴索莱指出，印度年轻大学毕业生一直以来的失业比例就明显偏高。但近年来，他们的数量急剧增长，与此同时，他们的家庭为了支付教育费用而背负的债务也不断增长。 “It’s a systematic failure. If the government’s not responsible, then who is?” asked Pranavi Tripathi, a 22-year-old business graduate protesting in Delhi on Thursday. “这是系统性的失败。如果政府不负责，那谁负责？”22岁的商科毕业生普拉纳维·特里帕蒂周四在德里参加抗议时说道。 Alex Travelli 是时报驻新德里记者，报道印度和南亚其他地区的商业和经济新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 美国将对80多个国家加征10%至12.5%关税
description: ANA SWANSON2026年7月24日周一，来自加拿大安大略省萨尼亚的卡车正在排队，准备经密歇根州休伦港进入美国。特朗普总统本周对加拿大进口商品加征了新关税。 Paul Sancya/Associated Press The Trump administration will impose tariffs of around 10 percent on goods from more than 80 countries on Friday, its latest effort to put in place an expansive protectionist policy that has been repeatedly challenged in court. 特朗普政府将于周五对来自80多个国家的商品加征约10%的关税，这是其落实一项大规模保护主义政策的最新举措，而该政策此前已多次在法院受到挑战。 The tariffs will range from 10 percent to 12.5 percent and take effect at 12:01 a.m. on Friday, replacing a global 10 percent duty set to lapse at the same time. Mr. Trump issued that earlier tariff in February, after the Supreme Court struck down duties he imposed last year. 关税税率将在10%至12.5%之间，于周五凌晨0时01分生效，取代届时到期的全球统一10%关税。特朗普于今年2月宣布了此前的这项关税，在此之前，最高法院推翻了他去年实施的关税。 The move provides fresh evidence of Mr. Trump’s intention to transform global trade, despite numerous court challenges and the protests of U.S. consumers and businesses that have been stuck with higher tax bills. Over the past 17 months, the Trump administration has cycled through trade law after trade law as it tries to build a system to shield the U.S. economy from foreign competition. 此举再次表明，尽管法院多次提出挑战，且美国消费者和企业因税负增加而抗议，特朗普仍有意改变全球贸易格局。过去17个月来，特朗普政府不断尝试各种贸易法，试图构建一套保护美国经济免受外国竞争影响的体系。 The duties will be issued under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, which allows the president to impose tariffs on foreign countries that engage in unreasonable or discriminatory trade practices. The administration has cited the failure of foreign countries to pass or enforce laws banning the importation of goods made by forced labor into their own countries, saying that disadvantages U.S. businesses that do follow such laws. 此次关税将依据1974年《贸易法》第301条征收。该条款允许总统对存在不合理或歧视性贸易做法的外国征收关税。特朗普政府声称：外国未能通过或执行禁止进口使用强迫劳动生产的商品的法律，这使遵守此类法律的美国企业在竞争中处于不利地位。 Canada, which will be subject to a 10 percent tariff under the arrangement, already prohibits importing forced labor goods. The European Union, also at 10 percent, has a ban that is scheduled to take effect in December 2027. But Trump officials say that the governments have not effectively enforced those laws. 根据这一安排，加拿大将被征收10%的关税。事实上，加拿大早已禁止进口强迫劳动产品。欧盟同样适用10%的关税，而其禁止进口强迫劳动产品的法规计划于2027年12月生效。但特朗普政府官员表示，这些政府并没有切实执行这些法律。 The United States has arguably the strongest restrictions on forced labor imports of any country. It has prohibited the importation of goods made with slave labor for nearly a century, though it still allows prison labor under conditions that labor organizations consider coercive. In 2021, the United States passed a law banning imports from a region of China where it had found forced labor to be rampant. 可以说，美国对强迫劳动产品进口的限制是世界上最严格的国家之一。近一个世纪以来，美国一直禁止进口奴隶劳动生产的商品，不过，它仍允许劳工组织认为具有强迫性质的监狱劳动。2021年，美国通过一项法律，禁止进口来自中国一个被认定强迫劳动现象普遍存在地区的产品。 The Trump administration also pushed Canada and Mexico to adopt a prohibition on imports made by forced labor as part of prior trade negotiations, and 10 other countries have committed to bans as part of trade deals negotiated over the past year, a senior administration official said. 一位政府高级官员表示，在此前的贸易谈判中，特朗普政府还推动加拿大和墨西哥采纳禁止进口强迫劳动产品的规定；此外，在过去一年达成的贸易协议中，还有另外10个国家承诺实施类似禁令。 But critics say the United States, too, has shortfalls on its labor protections. And some say that the administration has seized on forced labor as merely the most convenient way to reimpose tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court. 但批评人士指出，美国自身的劳工保护也存在不足。还有人表示，特朗普政府不过是借强迫劳动作为最方便的借口，以重新恢复被最高法院推翻的关税政策。 Peter Harrell, a visiting scholar at Georgetown Law School and a former Biden administration official, said that the small differential in tariffs between Canada and the European Union on one hand and China on the other “just brings home that USTR is using this forced labor investigation as a pretext to impose tariffs that Trump wants to impose for his own economic theories and preferences.” 乔治城大学法学院访问学者、前拜登政府官员彼得·哈雷尔表示，加拿大和欧盟与中国之间的关税差异很小，“这恰恰说明美国贸易代表办公室只是将强迫劳动调查作为借口，征收那些特朗普基于自己的经济理论和政策偏好本来就想征收的关税。” “It’s not really about forced labor,” he added. “这实际上与强迫劳动无关，”他补充道。 While Jamieson Greer, the U.S. trade representative, and other U.S. officials have publicly said they cannot prejudge the outcome of the trade investigations, administration officials have privately reassured multiple foreign governments that their tariff rates will end up being the same as in deals negotiated last year, people familiar with the discussions said. 尽管美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔及其他美国官员公开表示，他们不能预先判断贸易调查的结果，但据知情人士透露，政府官员私下已向多个外国政府保证，它们最终适用的关税税率将与去年谈判达成的协议一致。 “Trump’s next trade scheme is ordering USTR to reconstruct his illegal global tariffs under the guise of addressing forced labor,” Senator Ron Wyden, Democrat of Oregon, said in a Congressional hearing Wednesday. “If the administration wants to get serious about forced labor, the first step is to look at its own enforcement record.” “特朗普的下一个贸易计划是命令美国贸易代表办公室以解决强迫劳动问题为幌子，重新构建他那些已被裁定违法的全球关税，”俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登在周三的国会听证会上表示。“如果政府真想严肃对待强迫劳动问题，第一步就是审视自身的执法记录。” 美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔周三在国会山举行的参议院财政委员会听证会上接受质询。 The new tariffs will exempt oil and gas and certain national resources, as well as goods already covered under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, or national security-related tariffs Mr. Trump has imposed on cars, steel and other goods. 新关税将豁免石油、天然气及部分国家资源，以及美墨加协定涵盖的商品或特朗普已对汽车、钢铁等商品征收的国家安全相关关税。 More duties are likely to be on the way in the coming weeks. The administration has proposed another batch of tariffs, also using Section 301, on 15 countries and the European Union to offset what the White House calls unfair practices in their manufacturing sectors. An administration official said Thursday that an investigation was continuing. 未来数周可能还会有更多关税出台。政府已提议依据第301条对15个国家和欧盟再征收一批关税，用于补偿白宫所称这些国家制造业中的“不公平做法”。一名政府官员周四表示，相关调查仍在进行中。 Mr. Trump has long maintained that U.S. tariffs on imports were unfairly low, and he came into office wanting to transform that system. But his efforts have been met with plenty of stops, starts and setbacks, reflecting the fact that a president’s legal authority over tariff policy is in some ways limited. 特朗普长期以来一直认为，美国对进口商品征收的关税过低，因此他上任后便希望彻底改变这一体系。但他的努力屡屡受阻、反复启动又受挫，这也反映出，总统在关税政策上的法律权限在某些方面其实是有限的。 The Constitution gives Congress the power to regulate trade, but legislators have written numerous laws that allow the president to issue tariffs in certain circumstances. But typically, those laws are designed to help the president address unfair trade practices in certain countries or industries, not to replace the U.S. tariff system wholesale. 宪法赋予国会监管贸易的权力，但国会也制定了许多法律，允许总统在特定情形下征收关税。不过，这些法律通常都是为了帮助总统应对某些国家或行业的不公平贸易行为，而不是让总统全面取代美国现行的关税体系。 Mr. Harrell said that Mr. Trump’s use of Section 301 was much broader that the statute intended, and that it likely would be challenged in court. While Section 301 was supposed to be used to create leverage to push a country to address an unfair trade practice, he said, “Trump is reinterpreting the statute to try to impose perpetual tariffs on almost all imports.” 哈雷尔表示，特朗普对第301条的运用远远超出了这项法律原本的立法目的，很可能会再次受到法院挑战。他说，第301条本应被用来向他国施压，迫使其纠正不公平贸易行为，而“特朗普正在重新解读该条款，试图对几乎所有进口商品征收永久性关税”。 “They are showing that on tariffs, they can kind of run faster than the courts will, and they’re going to force the courts to keep playing catch up,” he added. “他们表明，在关税问题上，他们的行动速度可以比法院更快，并迫使法院不断疲于追赶，”他补充道。 The Supreme Court invalidated Mr. Trump’s preferred legal tool in February, when it said his use of an international emergency law to impose tariffs was unlawful and ordered roughly $160 billion in tariff revenue to be refunded. Mr. Trump had used the emergency law to announce his “Liberation Day” tariffs on foreign countries last year, and to penalize Canada, Mexico and China for their real or alleged role in channeling fentanyl to the United States. 今年2月，最高法院否定了特朗普最常使用的法律工具，裁定他依据一项国际紧急经济权力法征收关税属于违法，并下令退还约1600亿美元的关税收入。特朗普此前正是依据这部紧急状态法于去年宣布了针对外国的“解放日”关税，并以加拿大、墨西哥和中国在芬太尼流入美国问题上的真实或所谓责任为由施以惩罚。 After the Supreme Court decision, Mr. Trump turned to Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 as a stopgap, a law which had never been used to impose tariffs before. Section 122 allows a president to impose a tariff to address balance of payments issues, but it has a 150-day time limit that is set to expire early Friday. 最高法院作出裁决后，特朗普转而援引1974年《贸易法》第122条作为过渡措施。这项法律此前从未被用于征收关税。第122条允许总统为解决国际收支问题征收关税，但规定最长只能实施150天，而该时限将于本周五凌晨到期。 Mr. Trump’s use of Section 122 has also faced legal challenges. A group of small businesses and a coalition of states each sued the administration, claiming that the government did not satisfy the law’s strict criteria. In May, a majority of judges on a federal trade court agreed, handing down the second major tariff defeat against Mr. Trump. 特朗普援引第122条的做法同样遭遇了法律挑战。一批小企业和多个州的联盟相继对政府提起诉讼，声称政府未能满足该法律的严格适用条件。今年5月，联邦贸易法院多数法官支持了这一立场，这是特朗普第二次在关税问题上遭遇重大挫折。 The administration appealed the decision, and the courts have allowed the government to continue collecting the 10 percent tax on imports as the appeal progresses. 特朗普政府随后提起上诉，而法院允许政府在上诉审理期间继续征收这项10%的进口关税。 The provision that the administration is turning to next, Section 301, is more battle tested. Mr. Trump used it to impose tariffs on China in his first term, and his use of it has survived multiple challenges in court. But it has never before been used in such a sweeping way, to issue tariffs on dozens of countries simultaneously. 政府接下来准备援引的第301条经过了更多的司法检验。特朗普在第一任期内曾援引该条款对中国征收关税，且经受住了多轮法律挑战。但以此条款同时对数十个国家大规模征收关税尚属首次。 The administration also turned to another obscure trade law earlier this week, when Mr. Trump signed orders to impose a 50 percent tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian exports. The law, the Tariff Act of 1930, also known as the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act, was written by Congress to shield American businesses during the onset of the Great Depression, though many historians believe it actually deepened the crisis. The Section 338 provision of the act that the administration used had never been used to impose tariffs. 本周早些时候，特朗普政府还援引了另一部鲜为人知的贸易法律，当时特朗普签署命令，对价值数十亿美元的加拿大出口产品征收50%的关税。他所依据的是1930年《关税法》，也就是《斯穆特—霍利关税法》。这部法律是国会在大萧条初期制定的，旨在保护美国企业，但许多历史学家认为，它实际上加剧了当时的经济危机。而特朗普政府此次援引的该法第338条此前也从未被用来征收关税。 Testifying in Congress Wednesday, Mr. Greer said that the administration remained intent on imposing tariffs, regardless of the legal approach. 格里尔周三在国会作证时表示，无论采用何种法律依据，政府都将继续征收关税。 “The specific authorities this administration is using have changed, but the trade strategy has not,” Mr. Greer said. “We are committed to continuing to use tariffs and to negotiate deals to support the re-industrialization of our economy, protect American workers and increase their wages and shrink our trade deficit.” “这届政府具体援引的法律依据在变，但贸易战略没有变，”格里尔说。“我们将继续坚定地运用关税，并通过谈判达成协议，以支持我们经济的再工业化，保护美国工人，提高他们的薪资水平，缩减贸易赤字。” Tony Romm对本文有报道贡献。 Ana Swanson报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

the first step is to look at its own enforcement record.” “特朗普的下一个贸易计划是命令美国贸易代表办公室以解决强迫劳动问题为幌子，重新构建他那些已被裁定违法的全球关税，”俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登在周三的国会听证会上表示。“如果政府真想严肃对待强迫劳动问题，第一步就是审视自身的执法记录。” 美国贸易代表贾米森·格里尔周三在国会山举行的参议院财政委员会听证会上接受质询。 The new tariffs will exempt oil and gas and certain national resources, as well as goods already covered under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, or national security-related tariffs Mr. Trump has imposed on cars, steel and other goods. 新关税将豁免石油、天然气及部分国家资源，以及美墨加协定涵盖的商品或特朗普已对汽车、钢铁等商品征收的国家安全相关关税。 More duties are likely to be on the way in the coming weeks. The administration has proposed another batch of tariffs , also using Section 301, on 15 countries and the European Union to offset what the White House calls unfair practices in their manufacturing sectors. An administration official said Thursday that an investigation was continuing. 未来数周可能还会有更多关税出台。政府已提议依据第301条对15个国家和欧盟 再征收一批关税 ，用于补偿白宫所称这些国家制造业中的“不公平做法”。一名政府官员周四表示，相关调查仍在进行中。 Mr. Trump has long maintained that U.S. tariffs on imports were unfairly low, and he came into office wanting to transform that system. But his efforts have been met with plenty of stops, starts and setbacks, reflecting the fact that a president’s legal authority over tariff policy is in some ways limited. 特朗普长期以来一直认为，美国对进口商品征收的关税过低，因此他上任后便希望彻底改变这一体系。但他的努力屡屡受阻、反复启动又受挫，这也反映出，总统在关税政策上的法律权限在某些方面其实是有限的。 The Constitution gives Congress the power to regulate trade, but legislators have written numerous laws that allow the president to issue tariffs in certain circumstances. But typically, those laws are designed to help the president address unfair trade practices in certain countries or industries, not to replace the U.S. tariff system wholesale. 宪法赋予国会监管贸易的权力，但国会也制定了许多法律，允许总统在特定情形下征收关税。不过，这些法律通常都是为了帮助总统应对某些国家或行业的不公平贸易行为，而不是让总统全面取代美国现行的关税体系。 Mr. Harrell said that Mr. Trump’s use of Section 301 was much broader that the statute intended, and that it likely would be challenged in court. While Section 301 was supposed to be used to create leverage to push a country to address an unfair trade practice, he said, “Trump is reinterpreting the statute to try to impose perpetual tariffs on almost all imports.” 哈雷尔表示，特朗普对第301条的运用远远超出了这项法律原本的立法目的，很可能会再次受到法院挑战。他说，第301条本应被用来向他国施压，迫使其纠正不公平贸易行为，而“特朗普正在重新解读该条款，试图对几乎所有进口商品征收永久性关税”。 “They are showing that on tariffs, they can kind of run faster than the courts will, and they’re going to force the courts to keep playing catch up,” he added. “他们表明，在关税问题上，他们的行动速度可以比法院更快，并迫使法院不断疲于追赶，”他补充道。 The Supreme Court invalidated Mr. Trump’s preferred legal tool in February, when it said his use of an international emergency law to impose tariffs was unlawful and ordered roughly $160 billion in tariff revenue to be refunded. Mr. Trump had used the emergency law to announce his “Liberation Day” tariffs on foreign countries last year, and to penalize Canada, Mexico and China for their real or alleged role in channeling fentanyl to the United States. 今年2月，最高法院 否定 了特朗普最常使用的法律工具，裁定他依据一项国际紧急经济权力法征收关税属于违法，并下令退还约1600亿美元的关税收入。特朗普此前正是依据这部紧急状态法于去年宣布了针对外国的“解放日”关税，并以加拿大、墨西哥和中国在芬太尼流入美国问题上的真实或所谓责任为由施以惩罚。 After the Supreme Court decision, Mr. Trump turned to Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 as a stopgap, a law which had never been used to impose tariffs before. Section 122 allows a president to impose a tariff to address balance of payments issues, but it has a 150-day time limit that is set to expire early Friday. 最高法院作出裁决后，特朗普转而援引1974年《贸易法》第122条作为过渡措施。这项法律此前从未被用于征收关税。第122条允许总统为解决国际收支问题征收关税，但规定最长只能实施150天，而该时限将于本周五凌晨到期。 Mr. Trump’s use of Section 122 has also faced legal challenges. A group of small businesses and a coalition of states each sued the administration , claiming that the government did not satisfy the law’s strict criteria . In May, a majority of judges on a federal trade court agreed , handing down the second major tariff defeat against Mr. Trump. 特朗普援引第122条的做法同样遭遇了法律挑战。一批小企业和多个州的联盟相继 对政府提起诉讼 ，声称政府 未能满足该法律的严格适用条件 。今年5月，联邦贸易法院多数法官 支持 了这一立场，这是特朗普第二次在关税问题上遭遇重大挫折。 The administration appealed the decision, and the courts have allowed the government to continue collecting the 10 percent tax on imports as the appeal progresses. 特朗普政府随后提起上诉，而法院允许政府在上诉审理期间继续征收这项10%的进口关税。 The provision that the administration is turning to next, Section 301, is more battle tested. Mr. Trump used it to impose tariffs on China in his first term, and his use of it has survived multiple challenges in court. But it has never before been used in such a sweeping way, to issue tariffs on dozens of countries simultaneously. 政府接下来准备援引的第301条经过了更多的司法检验。特朗普在第一任期内曾援引该条款对中国征收关税，且经受住了多轮法律挑战。但以此条款同时对数十个国家大规模征收关税尚属首次。 The administration also turned to another obscure trade law earlier this week, when Mr. Trump signed orders to impose a 50 percent tariff on billions of dollars of Canadian exports. The law, the Tariff Act of 1930, also known as the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act, was written by Congress to shield American businesses during the onset of the Great Depression, though many historians believe it actually deepened the crisis. The Section 338 provision of the act that the administration used had never been used to impose tariffs. 本周早些时候，特朗普政府还援引了另一部鲜为人知的贸易法律，当时特朗普 签署命令 ，对价值数十亿美元的加拿大出口产品征收50%的关税。他所依据的是1930年《关税法》，也就是《斯穆特—霍利关税法》。这部法律是国会在大萧条初期制定的，旨在保护美国企业，但许多历史学家认为，它实际上加剧了当时的经济危机。而特朗普政府此次援引的该法第338条此前也从未被用来征收关税。 Testifying in Congress Wednesday, Mr. Greer said that the administration remained intent on imposing tariffs, regardless of the legal approach. 格里尔周三在国会作证时 表示 ，无论采用何种法律依据，政府都将继续征收关税。 “The specific authorities this administration is using have changed, but the trade strategy has not,” Mr. Greer said. “We are committed to continuing to use tariffs and to negotiate deals to support the re-industrialization of our economy, protect American workers and increase their wages and shrink our trade deficit.” “这届政府具体援引的法律依据在变，但贸易战略没有变，”格里尔说。“我们将继续坚定地运用关税，并通过谈判达成协议，以支持我们经济的再工业化，保护美国工人，提高他们的薪资水平，缩减贸易赤字。” Tony Romm对本文有报道贡献。 Ana Swanson 报道贸易和国际经济新闻，常驻华盛顿。她从事新闻工作已超过十年。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 多地40度高温，日本创造新词“酷暑日”
description: KIUKO NOTOYA, FRANCESCA REGALADO2026年7月24日周二，东京浅草寺。当天日本部分地区记录到至少40摄氏度的高温。 Issei Kato/Reuters Health and weather authorities in Japan were at a loss. A record number of people suffered from heat stroke last year as more cities experienced their highest-ever temperatures, despite official warnings about the dangers of excessive heat. 日本的卫生和气象当局一度束手无策。尽管官方针对过高温危险发出警告，但随着越来越多的城市出现有史以来的最高气温，去年中暑人数达到了创纪录的水平。 They decided to tackle the problem by giving it a name. Earlier this year, the Japan Meteorological Agency held a public poll to select a name for a day of temperatures of 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit) or higher, to signal that precautions were needed. The winner, with more than 40 percent of the vote, was kokushobi, meaning “cruel heat day.” 他们决定通过给这种现象起个名字来应对这个问题。今年早些时候，日本气象厅举行了一次公开投票，为气温达到或超过40摄氏度的日子征集名称，以提醒人们需要采取预防措施。最终胜出的是获得超过40%选票的“kokushobi”，意为“酷暑日”。 The term got its first use on Tuesday, when three cities in central Japan recorded 40-degree temperatures, a first for the country this year. Officials urged people to stay indoors, use air-conditioning and drink water. 该词于周二首次被使用，当时日本中部的三个城市录得了40度的高温，这是该国今年首次出现这种情况。官员们敦促民众留在室内、使用空调并多喝水。 There were signs that many people had heeded the warnings, as popular sites such as Osaka Castle and Kyoto’s Kiyomizu Temple saw smaller crowds than usual on Tuesday. 有迹象表明，许多人听从了警告，因为大阪城和京都清水寺等热门景点周二的游客比往常要少。 “Numbers are difficult to understand because people perceive them differently. By giving it the name ‘cruel heat day,’ people will understand it better just by hearing it, and they’ll feel that today is dangerous,” said Taro Kawasato, the assistant director of the Japan Meteorological Agency’s climate prediction division. “数字令人很难理解，因为人们对它们的感知各不相同。通过命名‘酷暑日’，人们一听就能更好地理解，并且会感觉到今天是危险的一天，”日本气象厅气候预测部门助理主任河里太郎（音）说。 The agency’s public poll in February and March garnered more than 400,000 votes, according to a statement. Kokushobi bested a dozen other terms that translate to “dangerously hot day,” “sweaty day” and “sauna day.” Mr. Kawasato said that meteorologists consulted with media and linguistics experts to form the list of names. 据声明，该机构在2月和3月进行的公开投票获得了超过40万张选票。“酷暑日” 从十几个其他候选词中脱颖而出，这些词翻译过来包括“危险高温日”、“汗流浃背日”和“桑拿日”。 河里太郎表示，气象学家在制定这份名称清单时，征询了媒体和语言学专家的意见。 And the dangers persist, even with slightly cooler weather on the horizon. Last week, even before the first kokushobi, 14 people died from heat-related illnesses, Japan’s Fire and Disaster Management Agency said. 尽管天气预计将略微转凉，这种危险依然存在。日本消防厅表示，上周，甚至在第一个“酷暑日”到来之前，已有14人死于与高温相关的疾病。 Japan is the latest country where officials have sought new terms to communicate the risks of rising temperatures. 多个国家使用新术语来传达气温上升的风险，日本是最新的一个。 In Britain, the Met Office began issuing extreme heat warnings in 2021 to highlight the impact of high temperatures on health, infrastructure and public services. (A red warning, the highest level, was issued when a heat wave baked European countries last month.) The United Kingdom Health Security Agency also issues “heat health alerts” for England to inform those in the health sector about the potential effects of high temperatures, especially for older people and others who are more vulnerable. 在英国，英国气象局于2021年开始发布极端高温警告，以强调高温对健康、基础设施和公共服务的影响。（上个月热浪炙烤欧洲国家时，该机构发布了最高级别的红色预警。）英国卫生安全局还针对英格兰发布“高温健康警报”， 向医疗卫生界人员通报高温的潜在影响，特别是对老年人和其他脆弱群体的影响。 In recent years, Chinese-language media have also searched for phrases to describe the summer heat. News headlines in Taiwan have described the weather as being like a sauna, with people “roasting like a sweet potato.” 近年来，中文媒体也在寻找词句来描述夏季的炎热。台湾的新闻头条将这种天气比作桑拿，人们“热成烤番薯”。 Health authorities in Shenzhen, a city on China’s southern coast, said in a social media post that temperatures in early July had risen to “barbecue mode.” During that period, 62 people called for ambulances because of heat stroke, two of whom died, the authorities said. 中国南部沿海城市深圳的卫生部门在社交媒体上发文称，7月上旬的气温已升至“烧烤模式”。该部门表示，在此期间，有62人因中暑呼叫救护车，其中两人死亡。 Mr. Kawasato said that the Japanese government started issuing heat stroke alerts in 2021, as sweltering days grew more frequent across the country. Last year, 30 locations recorded temperatures of at least 40 degrees Celsius, the highest of which was 41.8 degrees — or 107 degrees Fahrenheit — in Isesaki, a city north of Tokyo, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency. 河里表示，随着全国各地酷热天气日益频繁，日本政府于2021年开始发布中暑预警。根据日本气象厅的数据，去年共有30个地点的气温达到至少40摄氏度，其中最高气温出现在东京北部的伊势崎市，达到41.8度。 Heat stroke is among the heat-related illnesses that occur when the body loses the ability to cool itself, putting pressure on the heart. Symptoms can range from confusion, dizziness and nausea to a rapid heartbeat and shallow breathing. 中暑是与高温相关的疾病之一，当人体失去自我降温能力时就会发生，会给心脏带来负担。其症状可能包括意识模糊、头晕和恶心，甚至心跳加速和呼吸急促。 Last summer in Japan, emergency workers responded to more than 100,000 cases of heat stroke from May to September, the most since the Fire and Disaster Management Agency began collecting data in 2008. 去年夏天，在日本，从5月到9月，急救人员处理了超过10万起中暑病例，这是自日本消防厅2008年开始收集数据以来的最高纪录。 Kiuko Notoya是一名常驻东京的记者/研究员，报道日本新闻。 Francesca Regalado是时报记者，报道突发新闻。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 中国打造新型软实力：开放、低成本的人工智能
description: STEVE LOHR2026年7月24日上周在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上月之暗面的展位。月之暗面及其他中国科技公司一直致力于推动开源人工智能的发展。 Hector Retamal/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images In the Cold War era, “soft power” meant American movies and music that won hearts and minds abroad. Today, in the digital era, China is promoting a very different kind of soft power: its open, low-cost artificial intelligence technology. 在冷战时期，“软实力”意味着在海外赢得人心的美国电影和音乐。如今，在数字时代，中国正在推行一种截然不同的软实力：开放、低成本的人工智能技术。 In a speech last week, China’s leader, Xi Jinping, described so-called open-source A.I. as key to China’s ambitions to shape the global development of the technology. Mr. Xi hailed open-sourcing, in which much of the software can be freely shared and modified, as a “rare and historical opportunity” to spread the technology’s benefits worldwide. 在上周的一次讲话中，中国领导人习近平将所谓的开源人工智能描述为中国塑造该技术全球发展雄心的关键。习近平赞扬了开源模式——即大部分软件可以被自由共享和修改的模式——称其为将该技术的红利传播到全世界的“难得的历史机遇”。 Mr. Xi made clear that China will champion the open path as an alternative to relying on U.S. tech giants, whose A.I. software is typically closed and more costly. 习近平明确表示，中国将倡导这条开放的道路，以此作为依赖美国科技巨头的替代方案；后者的人工智能软件通常是封闭的，且成本更高。 “A.I. development should not be a solo performance by a single country,” Mr. Xi said, “but a symphony of global collaboration.” “人工智能发展不应该是某个国家的独奏，而应当是全球合作的交响，”习近平说。 The Chinese are calling for a new A.I. order amid a mounting battle for global dominance between the leading American companies and fast-moving Chinese rivals. 在美国领先企业与发展迅速的中国竞争对手争夺全球主导地位的斗争日益激烈之际，中方正呼吁建立一种新的人工智能秩序。 U.S. companies like OpenAI, Anthropic and Google hold their technology close, arguing that guarding the underlying code ensures greater security and control of powerful A.I. systems. Chinese companies like DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Z.ai and Alibaba have championed open-source A.I. They contend that those systems cost less, will accelerate global adoption and are no less secure. OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌等美国公司对其技术严加保密，它们认为保护底层代码能确保对强大人工智能系统拥有更高的安全性和控制力。而深度求索、月之暗面、智谱AI和阿里巴巴等中国公司则一直在倡导开源人工智能。它们认为，这些系统成本更低，将加速全球普及，而且安全性毫不逊色。 Promoting open-source artificial intelligence “serves China’s twin goals of bolstering its image as an inclusive A.I. leader and reducing global reliance on American A.I.,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution who is a China technology policy expert. 布鲁金斯学会研究员、中国科技政策专家凯尔·陈（音）表示，推广开源人工智能“有助于中国的双重目标：一是提升其作为包容性人工智能领导者的形象，二是减少全球对美国人工智能的依赖”。 上周，中国国家主席习近平在上海出席了一场人工智能会议。 As the Chinese companies rapidly close the gap in A.I. performance, the country’s rivalry with the United States has become more hostile. American companies have accused some Chinese competitors of improperly harvesting data from their systems to aid their own technology’s development. 随着中国公司迅速缩小在人工智能性能上的差距，中美之间的竞争也变得更具敌意。美国公司指责一些中国竞争对手不当抓取其系统数据，帮助发展自己的技术。 Last month, Anthropic sent a letter to two U.S. senators accusing the Chinese tech giant Alibaba of “brazenly” and “illicitly” trying to copy its technology using 24,000 fraudulent accounts. Alibaba has denied any wrongdoing. 上个月，Anthropic致信两名美国参议员，指责中国科技巨头阿里巴巴试图利用2.4万个虚假账户“公然”且“非法”复制其技术。阿里巴巴否认有任何不当行为。 The Trump administration is taking such allegations seriously. On Wednesday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatened to impose sanctions on Chinese A.I. companies. 特朗普政府正在认真对待这些指控。周三，财政部长贝森特威胁要对中国人工智能公司实施制裁。 “We support open-source A.I. and the innovation it unlocks,” Mr. Bessent posted on X. “But open source is not open season on American IP,” referring to intellectual property. “我们支持开源人工智能及其带来的创新，”贝森特在X上发帖称。“但开源并不意味着对美国IP的开放狩猎，”IP是指知识产权。 U.S. tech executives and investors also worry that the Chinese open-source technology could change the economics of A.I. production. Their models are more efficient, eating up less computing power. That innovation is driven partly by necessity because U.S. trade restrictions have limited access to the most advanced A.I. chips from Nvidia. 美国科技高管和投资者也担心，中国的开源技术可能会改变人工智能生产的经济学。中国的模型更高效，消耗的算力更少。这种创新部分是出于无奈，因为美国的贸易限制阻碍了它们获取英伟达最先进人工智能芯片的途径。 If the Chinese A.I. alternatives are nearly as good and less expensive — estimates range from 50 percent to 90 percent for some tasks — they could threaten the business plans and sky-high valuations of the American A.I. leaders. And the Chinese technology is increasingly being embraced by engineers and companies in the United States, seeking to trim costs. 如果中国的人工智能替代方案几乎一样好且更便宜——据估计，在某些任务中成本可降低50%至90%——它们可能会威胁到美国人工智能领导者的商业计划和极高的估值。此外，为了削减成本，中国的技术正日益被美国的工程师和公司所接受。 The China strategy is “to capture market share across the world, even if it doesn’t translate into profits right away,” said Wendy Chang, a senior analyst at the Mercator Institute for China Studies, a think tank. 智库墨卡托中国研究所高级分析师温迪·张表示，中国的战略是“抢占全球市场份额，即使这不会立即转化为利润”。 深度求索位于杭州的总部。 Proponents of the open approach point to Linux, an open-source software operating system, as a reason for optimism. The software runs most of the computers in internet data centers and has benefited from many people poring over the code and making fixes. 开放策略的支持者以开源软件操作系统Linux作为乐观的理由。该软件运行在互联网数据中心的大多数计算机上，并得益于众多开发者对源代码的深入研究和修复。 Still, computer experts agree that A.I. is a more nuanced case. There is more than code involved, notably the data used for training a model. And A.I. models form judgments and can reason. 尽管如此，计算机专家们一致认为，人工智能的情况更为复杂微妙。它所涉及的不仅仅是代码，尤其是用于训练模型的数据。而且，人工智能模型会做出判断并能够进行推理。 There are also security concerns. Some security experts insist that the open-source approach of releasing both software and the numerical settings for training A.I. models, known as weights, greatly increases the risk of the technology’s being used for cyberattacks or even to help build bioweapons. 安全方面也存在隐患。一些安全专家坚称，将软件和用于训练人工智能模型的数值参数（即权重）一并公开的开源做法极大地增加了人工智能技术被用于网络攻击、甚至帮助制造生物武器的风险。 And the heavy influence of the Chinese government on its companies raises potential data protection and security concerns. 此外，中国政府对本国公司的巨大影响力也引发了潜在的数据保护和安全担忧。 But the closed models of the Silicon Valley companies have had their own security glitches. This week, OpenAI disclosed that a model it was testing went rogue and attacked the computer systems of another company. The targeted company, Hugging Face, said it had deployed a Chinese open-source model from Z.ai to analyze data and counter the attack. 但是，硅谷公司的闭源模型也存在着自身的安全漏洞。本周，OpenAI披露其正在测试的一个模型失控，攻击了另一家公司的计算机系统。受攻击的公司Hugging Face表示，它部署了来自智谱AI的中国开源模型来分析数据，抵御了这次攻击。 Now, China has outlined a plan to leverage its open-source advantage as a diplomatic tool. 现在，中国已经制定一项计划，将其开源优势作为一种外交工具加以利用。 The concept of open-source A.I. software as an instrument of soft power has been popularized in technology circles. It suggests influence through persuasion and desire — something people want — rather than the coercive “hard power” of military might and economic muscle. 将开源人工智能软件作为一种软实力工具的概念已在科技圈流行开来。这一理念主张通过说服和满足渴望——即提供人们想要的东西——来施加影响力，而不是通过军事力量和经济实力这种强制性的“硬实力”。 The open path offers a low-cost on-ramp to A.I. for software engineers and for nations seeking to catch the next wave of technology. 这条开放之路为软件工程师和寻求赶上下一波技术浪潮的国家提供了一个低成本的人工智能入门通道。 英伟达创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋。 “Those who benefit from free A.I. software certainly recognize it,” said Lawrence Lessig, a professor at Harvard Law School and a technology policy expert. “From a political perspective, it’s an enormous gain for China.” “那些从免费人工智能软件中受益的人肯定认识到了这一点，”哈佛法学院教授、科技政策专家劳伦斯·莱斯格说。“从政治角度来看，这对中国来说是一个巨大的收益。” China, an authoritarian power, often uses the language of openness in outreach overseas, especially to the developing world. And in recent years, it has used A.I. in those efforts, setting up joint A.I. development and education centers in dozens of nations. This year, China established the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization to shape A.I. governance principles and to promote A.I. adoption and training in China-friendly countries. 作为一个威权大国，中国在海外拓展特别是面向发展中国家时经常使用开放的语言。近年来，它将人工智能融入这些努力中，在数十个国家建立了联合人工智能发展和教育中心。今年，中国成立了世界人工智能合作组织，旨在塑造人工智能治理原则，并在对中国友好的国家推广人工智能的应用和培训。 In his speech, Mr. Xi pledged further investments. That included 5,000 A.I. training and seminar programs for students and workers in developing countries over the next five years, as well as new or enlarged A.I. initiatives in Africa, Asia and Latin America. 在演讲中，习近平承诺将进一步增加投资。其中包括未来五年内为发展中国家的学生和工人提供5000个人工智能培训和研讨项目，以及在非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲开展新的或规模更大的人工智能倡议。 On the same day as Mr. Xi’s speech, the People’s Daily, the Communist Party’s official newspaper, published an article on China’s A.I. investments abroad with a litany of training and joint-development programs. 就在习近平发表演讲的同一天，中共官方报纸《人民日报》发表了一篇关于中国在海外进行人工智能投资的文章，列举了一系列培训和联合开发项目。 Its self-congratulatory conclusion: “China is helping countries around the world, particularly those in the Global South, strengthen their capabilities, winning broad international recognition and support.” 文章以自我赞许的口吻总结道：“中国的务实合作正跨越山海，帮助世界各国特别是全球南方国家加强能力建设，获得国际社会广泛支持认同。” Xinyun Wu自台湾台北、 Alan Rappeport自华盛顿对本文有报道贡献。 Steve Lohr撰写关于科技及其对经济、就业和劳动市场的影响的文章。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
